text:
Maria: heads-up i just pushed a changelog with version tag `v2.0..1` and now the release job is sobbing. sorryyyy :grimacing:
Ajay: ...uh oh. can you paste the commit or the file that broke it?
Maria: here’s the snippet from package.yaml i pushed:
Maria: ```yaml
version: "v2.0..1"
metadata:
	- author: maria
```
Maria: yes i used a tab AND an extra dot. triple threat. :sweat_smile:
deploy-bot: Release pipeline failed: YAML::ParserError at line 2 column 1 - unexpected token (reported by release-runner)
Leo: grammar police: "one dot, one dot, go home" :joy: also tabs are the cliff notes of chaos
Ajay: quick fix is: change to `v2.0.1` and replace the tab with two spaces. i’ll re-run the job when you push the fix.
Maria: pushing fix now... thanks ajay! :pray:
deploy-bot: Rerun started by Ajay (release-runner id: rr-9234)
deploy-bot: Rerun succeeded — deployment to staging :rocket:
Maria: saved by ajay and two-space indentation. offering brownies (virtual or otherwise) :brownie:
Leo: i’ll take virtual + memes. also we should add a pre-commit check for version sanity.
Ajay: agree, quick linter rule: versions must match regex `^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$` and no tabs in yaml.
Maria: noted. PR incoming for the linter and the apology brownies. :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
